label: s2_sub_038_man_01
text: You would be wise to stay away... I’m a danger to\nall who approach...

label: s2_sub_038_man_02
text: Leave me be...OK?

label: s2_sub_038_man_04
text: Wait... Is it even possible? Are you...are you\nlike me?

label: s2_sub_038_man_05
text: Then you must have heard the call...

label: s2_sub_038_man_06
text: I see... What has called you here, then...?

label: s2_sub_038_select_01
text: The light?

label: s2_sub_038_select_02
text: The wind?

label: s2_sub_038_select_03
text: The darkness?

label: s2_sub_038_select_04
text: A hunch?

label: s2_sub_038_select_05
text: I’m not sure...

label: s2_sub_038_man_07
text: Oh. Light, huh... That’s...that’s not really what I’m\ngoing for...

label: s2_sub_038_man_08
text: Huh? The wind?! I guess that’s pretty cool...\nThe wind... Yeah, I like the ring of that!

label: s2_sub_038_man_09
text: Ah, the darkness... Yes, darkness is good...\nIt quenches the thirst of my pitch-black soul...

label: s2_sub_038_man_10
text: A hunch? That’s no good... Come on, put a little\neffort into this!

label: s2_sub_038_man_11
text: You can feel it, right...? Feel the stirring of the\npower in your hand there...

label: s2_sub_038_select_06
text: My right hand?

label: s2_sub_038_select_07
text: My left hand?

label: s2_sub_038_man_12
text: You feel it in your right hand? Uh, that won’t do...\nThat just won’t do at all...

label: s2_sub_038_man_13
text: Yes! Yes, your left hand! I knew you were like me!

label: s2_sub_038_man_14
text: Allow me to teach you, my kindred spirit, the\nsign of twilight!

label: s2_sub_011_system_01
text: You learned the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Be Still, My Left Hand! emote[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\nfrom the boy!

label: s2_sub_038_man_npc
text: Beware the power in your left hand, kindred\nspirit. Don’t let it consume you...
